items.title_zh: Anthropic 推出面向财务顾问的 Claude，自动化财富管理工作流
items.title_en: Anthropic Launches Claude for Financial Advisors to Automate Wealth Management Workflows
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布推出面向财务顾问的 Claude 产品，目标是自动化财富管理领域的工作流程。该产品延续 Claude 在企业场景的落地思路，将 AI 能力嵌入财务顾问的日常业务中，帮助处理原本依赖人工的流程性工作。目前官方尚未披露具体的定价、可用范围与客户案例，但此举显示出 AI 厂商正加速向金融等垂直行业渗透。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Launches Claude for Financial Advisors to Automate Wealth Management Workflows FF News
items.why_zh: 显示 AI 大模型厂商正加速向财富管理等垂直金融场景落地。
items.why_en: It shows AI model vendors are accelerating into vertical financial use cases like wealth management.

items.title_zh: Knowtex 成立前沿医疗 AI 实验室
items.title_en: Knowtex launches frontier healthcare AI lab
items.summary_zh: 据 Fierce Healthcare 报道，Knowtex 宣布成立一个聚焦前沿方向的医疗 AI 实验室。该实验室将围绕医疗健康领域的人工智能研究展开工作，但报道未披露具体的研究方向、投入规模或合作方。此举反映出医疗行业正持续吸引 AI 力量进入，围绕临床与健康场景的前沿探索不断增多。
items.summary_en: Knowtex launches frontier healthcare AI lab Fierce Healthcare
items.why_zh: 表明医疗健康正成为前沿 AI 研究的重要落地领域。
items.why_en: It signals healthcare is becoming a key frontier for AI research.

items.title_zh: CCN 推出情报平台并成立国家情报委员会
items.title_en: CCN Launches Intelligence Platform and National Intelligence Council
items.summary_zh: CCN 宣布推出一个情报平台，并同步成立国家情报委员会。根据 PR Newswire 发布的消息，该平台与委员会的组合意在整合情报相关能力与治理架构。目前公开信息有限，尚未披露平台的具体功能、技术细节以及委员会的成员构成。
items.summary_en: CCN Launches Intelligence Platform and National Intelligence Council PR Newswire
items.why_zh: 情报平台与治理机构的同步推出，可能影响相关领域的数据与决策方式。
items.why_en: Launching an intelligence platform with a governing council could shape data and decision-making in the field.

items.title_zh: Salesforce 联合英伟达推出 Koa 推理大模型，挑战闭源前沿模型
items.title_en: Salesforce and Nvidia Launch Koa Reasoning Model to Challenge Closed-Source Frontier Models
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 15 日消息，本周在规模盛大的 Dreamforce 技术大会上，Salesforce 最重要的发布成果之一就是一款名叫 Koa 的全新 AI 模型。Koa 是该公司首款推理大模型，基于英伟达开源权重的 Nemotron 模型打造。两家企业联合完成了 Koa 的后续微调训练，让其擅长处理销售、市场营销以及客户服务类任务。 Koa 是一个很典型的例子：面向企业的 AI 需求，正在和前沿 AI 实验室所提供的产品逐渐分化。那些闭源 AI 实验室更希望企业直接把文件、代码、提示词以及反馈全部上传到自家模型与智能体当中，并为此花费数百万美元。 而借助这款模型，Salesforce 向它的企业客户提供了以下能力： 作为闭源前沿大模型之外、采用开源权重的备选方案 专门针对实际业务任务训练（而不是主攻高难度数学解题） 训练过程没有摄入任何真实客户数据，因此不存在向外泄露客户数据的风险 有助于降低 AI 使用成本，完成同等业务任务消耗的词元（Token）数量更少 可以根据业务需求，经由 AI 网关实现自动调度路由 完全遵从客户的数据管控要求，安全机制深度内嵌于 Salesforce 平台内部 IT之家注意到，Koa 将作为 Agentforce 平台上的可选模型。客户可以在该平台搭建 AI 智能体，用来处理客服问答、预约排期这类重复性工作。 “此前我们已经开发过不少面向专项任务的…
items.summary_en: At Dreamforce, Salesforce unveiled Koa, its first reasoning model, built on Nvidia's open-weight Nemotron and jointly fine-tuned for sales, marketing and customer service tasks. Koa will be an optional model on the Agentforce platform and was trained without real customer data. Salesforce positions it as a lower-cost, open-weight alternative to closed-source frontier models.
items.why_zh: 它是企业级 AI 需求与闭源前沿模型分化的标志性案例，强调开源权重、数据安全与成本优势。
items.why_en: It exemplifies how enterprise AI needs are diverging from closed-source frontier models, emphasizing open weights, data security and cost.

items.title_zh: 欧洲芯片初创公司 Axelera 拿下 AI 工厂供应协议，并发布第二款芯片
items.title_en: European chip startup Axelera wins AI factory supply deals and launches second chip
items.summary_zh: 据路透社报道，欧洲芯片初创公司 Axelera 获得了 AI 工厂相关的供应协议，并发布了其第二款芯片。这意味着该公司在 AI 算力硬件领域取得新的商业化进展，同时通过产品迭代扩展自身芯片阵容。报道未披露协议的具体金额、客户名称以及新芯片的详细规格。
items.summary_en: European chip startup Axelera wins AI factory supply deals and launches second chip Reuters
items.why_zh: 欧洲本土 AI 芯片厂商获得供应订单并迭代产品，关系到区域算力自主与竞争格局。
items.why_en: A European AI chip player winning supply deals and iterating products matters for regional compute sovereignty and competition.

items.title_zh: 荣耀MagicOS 11 操作系统正式发布：全新流光通透设计，最高省 60GB 存储空间
items.title_en: Honor Launches MagicOS 11 with Fluid Translucent Design, Up to 60GB Storage Savings
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 15 日消息，荣耀MagicOS 11 操作系统今日正式发布，新系统主打全新液态玻璃材质，拥有流光通透美学设计，即日起启动正式版不限量尝鲜，适配多款机型。 IT之家了解到，MagicOS 11 首发荣耀琉光架构，从底层重构安卓，带来更加通透的液态玻璃效果。拥有行业首创动态液态玻璃，支持提前布局统一渲染， 可无级调节通透程度 ，号称“功耗几乎零增长”。 荣耀本次为 MagicOS 11 带来全新蜂鸟架构，在安卓领域首创液态动效，采用全新物理模型，支持变参数回弹、链式回弹模型等，让用户拥有更流畅的使用体验， 号称“全系列全机型整机流畅度提升 20%+” 。 同时，本次更新还将新增多协议快充，让无线充电体验更加高效。新系统将支持「存储空间优化技术 2.0」，靠无损压缩存储数据和自动清理冗余文件，让手机增加更多存储空间，宣称最高省 60GB。 此外，本次更新还将支持鸿雁 AI 云图特性，让手机自动选择最优网络，提升弱网场景使用体验，并支持两副蓝牙耳机同时连接一台设备。影像方面，这次升级将带来 4K Live 录中拍，用户可在摄像时同步拍摄实况照片。
items.summary_en: Honor officially launched MagicOS 11, featuring a liquid glass design and a rebuilt Android architecture called Liuguang for smoother, translucent visuals. It adds the Hummingbird animation architecture, faster multi-protocol charging, storage optimization that can save up to 60GB, AI network selection and more. The update also brings 4K Live photo capture while recording video.
items.why_zh: 新系统在动效、存储与 AI 网络等底层体验上的升级，反映手机厂商以系统优化争夺用户。
items.why_en: The update's improvements in animation, storage and AI networking show phone makers competing through system-level optimization.

items.title_zh: GE HealthCare 推出 AI 驱动的运营系统
items.title_en: GE HealthCare launches AI-driven operations system
items.summary_zh: 据 Fierce Healthcare 报道，GE HealthCare 发布了一套由 AI 驱动的运营系统。该系统旨在以人工智能支持医疗机构的运营管理，但报道未披露具体功能模块、部署方式与客户信息。此举表明医疗设备与健康科技公司正将 AI 从影像诊断等临床环节延伸到医疗运营层面。
items.summary_en: GE HealthCare launches AI-driven operations system Fierce Healthcare
items.why_zh: 显示 AI 正从临床诊断扩展到医院与医疗体系的运营管理环节。
items.why_en: It shows AI expanding from clinical diagnostics into healthcare operations and management.

items.title_zh: 智谱完成约50亿美元融资，主要用于下代模型研发
items.title_en: Zhipu Completes About $5 Billion Funding Round for Next-Gen Model R&D
items.summary_zh: 智谱完成约50亿美元融资，主要用于下代模型研发 三易生活
items.summary_en: Zhipu has completed a funding round of about $5 billion, with proceeds mainly for next-generation model R&D. The round is a notable size among Chinese foundation model companies. Investors and valuation details were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 巨额融资将为下一代大模型研发提供弹药，也反映资本对基础模型赛道的持续押注。
items.why_en: The large round fuels next-gen model R&D and reflects continued capital bets on foundation models.

items.title_zh: 高通官宣努比亚 NaviX Ultra 手机搭载第五代骁龙 8 至尊版移动平台
items.title_en: Qualcomm announces Nubia NaviX Ultra will feature Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 15 日消息，高通官方今日宣布， 努比亚 NaviX Ultra 手机将搭载第五代骁龙 8 至尊版移动平台 ，支持豆包手机助手带来生成式 AI 和智能体 AI 体验。 据努比亚官方介绍，努比亚 NaviX Ultra 将搭载行业首个集成指纹识别的独立 AI 按键，支持方言识别能力、语音唤醒能力，并内置 Seed 最新全双工语音大模型。 另外，这款新机还搭载 2 亿像素主摄，旗舰三摄系统；星河冷控散热系统，7100m㎡立体均热 VC；机身厚度仅 7.62mm，7100mAh 第 5 代南海电池；星穹全域通信系统，全链路网络通讯增强引擎。 参考IT之家此前报道，努比亚 NaviX Ultra 由中兴通讯与字节跳动联合研发，搭载豆包手机助手，被称为“豆包手机二代”。努比亚 NaviX Ultra 合作商也已公布， 包括高通骁龙、京东方、长鑫存储、三星半导体、汇顶科技等 。
items.summary_en: Qualcomm announced that Nubia's NaviX Ultra will be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 platform and support the Doubao phone assistant for generative and agentic AI. The phone features an industry-first independent AI button with fingerprint recognition, dialect recognition, voice wake-up, and Seed's newest full-duplex voice model, plus a 200MP main camera, a 7100mAh battery, and a 7.62mm body. Co-developed by ZTE and ByteDance, it is dubbed the second-generation 'Doubao phone'.
items.why_zh: 该机由中兴与字节跳动联合研发并深度集成豆包AI，显示生成式AI与智能体能力正成为旗舰手机的重要差异化卖点。
items.why_en: Co-developed by ZTE and ByteDance with deep Doubao integration, the device shows generative and agentic AI becoming a key differentiator for flagship phones.

items.title_zh: 多点数智即将上线豆包小程序“多点闪购” 已完成内测
items.title_en: Dmall to launch 'Duodian Flash Buy' mini-program on Doubao after completing beta test
items.summary_zh: 多点数智即将上线豆包小程序“多点闪购” 已完成内测 观点网
items.summary_en: According to Guandian, Dmall is about to launch the 'Duodian Flash Buy' mini-program on Doubao and has completed internal testing. The move brings the digital retail services provider into ByteDance's Doubao ecosystem, potentially opening a new AI assistant traffic channel for retail and instant retail.
items.why_zh: 零售服务商接入豆包小程序，反映AI助手正成为电商与本地生活的新流量入口，零售企业开始争夺AI生态内的用户触点。
items.why_en: A retail services provider joining Doubao's mini-program ecosystem shows AI assistants are becoming a new traffic gateway for e-commerce and local life services.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek研究员刘胜与深夜独白火了“我们研究强大、快速、普惠的人工智能并将其开源
items.title_en: DeepSeek researcher Liu Sheng's late-night monologue goes viral: 'We research powerful, fast, inclusive AI and open-source it'
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek研究员刘胜与深夜独白火了“我们研究强大、快速、普惠的人工智能并将其开源 财富号
items.summary_en: A late-night monologue by DeepSeek researcher Liu Sheng has gone viral, in which he says the team researches powerful, fast and inclusive AI and open-sources it. The remark echoes DeepSeek's open-source strategy and has drawn attention to the team's culture and China's open-source LLM race.
items.why_zh: DeepSeek研究员的表态再度强化其开源普惠形象，凸显开源路线在中国大模型竞争中的关注度与影响力。
items.why_en: The researcher's remark reinforces DeepSeek's open-source and inclusive image, highlighting the attention and influence of open-source strategies in China's LLM race.

items.title_zh: 净买入近9亿港元 连续加仓智谱抛售腾讯
items.title_en: Nearly HK$900 million net buying: continued accumulation of Zhipu, selling of Tencent
items.summary_zh: 净买入近9亿港元 连续加仓智谱抛售腾讯 新浪财经
items.summary_en: According to Sina Finance, funds recorded nearly HK$900 million in net buying, continuously adding to Zhipu while selling Tencent. The moves suggest investors are rotating within AI large-model names, betting on Zhipu's outlook while reassessing Tencent.
items.why_zh: 资金连续加仓智谱、减持腾讯，可能反映投资者对AI大模型公司与互联网巨头的前景判断出现分化。
items.why_en: Continued buying of Zhipu and selling of Tencent may reflect diverging investor views on AI large-model companies versus internet giants.

items.title_zh: 国家网信办发布一批执法典型案例，涉网页篡改、数据泄露、个人信息泄露等
items.title_en: China's Cyberspace Administration Publishes Enforcement Cases Covering Web Tampering, Data Leaks and AI Content Labeling
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 15 日消息，“网信中国”微信公众号今天（15 日）发文通报，近段时间以来，全国网信系统认真贯彻落实《网络安全法》《数据安全法》《个人信息保护法》《网络数据安全管理条例》等法律规定，持续加大网络安全、数据安全、个人信息保护等领域执法力度，依法查处一批涉 网页篡改、设置恶意程序、数据泄露、个人信息泄露、违法收集使用个人信息、违法出境个人信息、未落实人工智能生成合成内容标识要求、新技术新应用未经评估上线提供服务 等典型案件。 国家网信办有关负责人表示，网络安全、数据安全、个人信息保护事关国家安全、社会公共利益和人民群众合法权益，相关单位和企业要严格落实法律法规要求，切实履行主体责任，筑牢网络空间安全屏障。网信部门将持续加大相关执法工作力度，坚决查处各类突出违法违规问题，以高质效网络执法护航网信事业高质量发展。 IT之家附上此次通报的相关案例。 上海某电子有限公司网页篡改案 网信部门核查发现，该企业 2020 年以来，长期忽视门户网站后台系统存在的管理员账号弱口令问题，未及时监测处置相关系统遭暴力破解等安全风险，该后台系统 2026 年 4 月遭攻击，网站源文件被植入恶意代码，通过搜索引擎检索网站相关内容，结果出现大量严重违法和不良信息。该企业未依法履行网络安全保护义务，发生网络安全事件时未及时启动应急预案并采取补救措施，未及时向有关主管部门报告，违反《网络安全法》等法…
items.summary_en: China's Cyberspace Administration released a batch of enforcement cases covering website tampering, malicious programs, data and personal information leaks, illegal collection or cross-border transfer of personal data, failure to label AI-generated content, and launching new technologies without assessment. In one case, a Shanghai electronics firm's portal was breached in April 2026 after long-unaddressed weak administrator passwords, with malicious code injected into its site files. Regulators urged companies to fulfill their security obligations and said enforcement will keep intensifying.
items.why_zh: 显示 AI 生成内容标识、新技术上线评估已被纳入常态化执法，为行业划出合规红线。
items.why_en: Signals that AI content labeling and pre-launch assessment of new technologies are now part of routine enforcement, setting compliance red lines.

items.title_zh: 南向资金今日净买入近9亿港元，智谱获买入居前
items.title_en: Southbound Funds Net Buy Nearly HK$900 Million, With Zhipu Among Top Buys
items.summary_zh: 南向资金今日净买入近9亿港元，智谱获买入居前 Moomoo
items.summary_en: Southbound capital recorded a net inflow of nearly HK$900 million today, with Zhipu among the top buys, according to Moomoo. No breakdown of individual purchase amounts or the reasons behind the flows was disclosed.
items.why_zh: 南向资金动向常被视为内地资金对港股 AI 资产偏好的信号。
items.why_en: Southbound flows are watched as a signal of mainland investor appetite for Hong Kong-listed AI assets.

items.title_zh: 美国参议院拟议新法案：AI 企业需证明自身已拿出防范风险的措施
items.title_en: US Senate Weighs Bill Requiring AI Firms to Prove They Have Taken Risk-Prevention Measures
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 15 日消息，据路透社今天（15 日）报道，美国参议院一名助理和一名熟悉磋商情况的游说人士透露，美国参议院谈判各方就一项 AI 监管法案展开讨论。法案拟要求 AI 企业证明 自身已采取合理预防措施，防止旗下工具造成伤害 。 上周，Anthropic 研究员雅各布 · 考克森宣布辞职，提到部分原因是：“开发 AI 的人真心相信，这项技术可能在本世纪 20 年代结束前杀死我们所有人。” 这番表态加剧了外界对 AI 潜在危险的担忧。几家 AI 巨头的负责人随后呼吁放缓技术发展，全球 AI 概念股在当地时间 14 日纷纷迎来下跌。 上述两名知情人士透露，议员们考虑赋予美国商务部长权力， 要求 AI 开发者拿出证据，证明履行了“注意义务” ，即采取合理措施防止伤害。商务部长还可派政府审计人员直接测试企业产品。不过，法案仍处于磋商阶段，即便国会通过，成为法律的希望也不大。 上周五的消息称，谈判各方还考虑让联邦法院参与处理另一种情况：美国政府认为某些 AI 模型不安全，希望阻止发布。企业可以向联邦法院提出异议，挑战政府的决定。美国政府究竟能获得多大权力、具体如何安排，仍有待磋商。 IT之家获悉，另一名游说人士和一名参议院助理透露，涉及联邦法院的条款还拟禁止各州执行本州法律中针对 AI 模型某些风险的规定。
items.summary_en: Reuters reports that US Senate negotiators are discussing an AI oversight bill that would require AI companies to show they have taken reasonable precautions, a "duty of care," to prevent harm from their tools, and could let the Commerce Secretary demand evidence and have government auditors test products directly. Other provisions under discussion would let federal courts review government moves to block model releases and would bar states from enforcing certain AI-risk rules. The bill remains in negotiation and faces long odds of becoming law.
items.why_zh: 若落地，将把“注意义务”与政府产品测试引入 AI 监管，直接影响前沿模型的开发与发布节奏。
items.why_en: If enacted, a duty-of-care standard plus government product testing would reshape how frontier models are developed and released.

items.title_zh: 国家超算互联网累计上线智能体 500 余个、覆盖 170 余个核心计算场景
items.title_en: China's National Supercomputing Internet Tops 500 Agents Across 170+ Core Computing Scenarios
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 15 日消息，据财联社今日消息，曙光智算总裁何牧君在 2026 算力网发展大会透露，国家超算互联网平台已建成材料计算、工业仿真等 6 大智能体矩阵。 据介绍，国家超算互联网已覆盖 170 余个核心计算场景， 累计上线智能体 500 余个 、 技能 1 万余项 。何牧君表示，在国家超算互联网上，用户无需精通编程，依托 1.6 万余个内容组件与对话式构建工具，即可像搭积木一样组建专属科学计算智能体。 IT之家注：2023 年，科技部组织召开超算互联网发展工作部署会，统筹超算互联网建设启动工作；2023 年 4 月，国家超算互联网平台建设工作正式启动，国家超算互联网联合体成立，国家高性能计算机工程技术研究中心任理事长单位。 今年 1 月，国家超算互联网平台曾发布消息，宣布 国家超算互联网用户规模正式突破 100 万 。
items.summary_en: Shuguang Zhisuan president He Mujun said at the 2026 Computing Network Development Conference that China's National Supercomputing Internet has built six agent matrices, including materials computing and industrial simulation, covering more than 170 core computing scenarios with over 500 agents and 10,000-plus skills online. Users can assemble their own scientific computing agents via 16,000+ content components and conversational tools, he said.
items.why_zh: 说明国家级算力平台正从“提供算力”转向以智能体和技能供给科研与工业场景。
items.why_en: Shows national computing platforms shifting from selling raw compute to supplying agents and skills for research and industry.

items.title_zh: 豆包二代手机9月16日发售，能否突破互联网“生态墙”实现AI主动服务？
items.title_en: Doubao Second-Gen Phone to Launch Sept 16, Testing Whether AI Can Break Through Internet "Ecosystem Walls"
items.summary_zh: 豆包二代手机9月16日发售，能否突破互联网“生态墙”实现AI主动服务？ blog.csdn.net
items.summary_en: The second-generation Doubao phone is set to go on sale on September 16, with attention focused on whether it can break down the "ecosystem walls" between internet platforms to deliver proactive AI services. Few details on specifications, pricing, AI features or partners have been disclosed so far.
items.why_zh: AI 手机的竞争焦点正从硬件参数转向能否打通跨应用的数据与服务。
items.why_en: Competition in AI phones is increasingly about breaking down cross-app data and service silos, not just hardware.

items.title_zh: 2026 软科世界一流学科排名发布：中国内地高校在 22 个学科排名世界第一，清华大学独占 7 个
items.title_en: 2026 ShanghaiRanking GRAS Released: Mainland Chinese Universities Top 22 Subjects, Tsinghua Leads 7
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 15 日消息，高等教育评价机构软科今日正式发布 2026“软科世界一流学科排名” （ShanghaiRanking's Global Ranking of Academic Subjects，简称 GRAS）。 2026 年排名覆盖 57 个学科，涉及理学、工学、生命科学、医学和社会科学五大领域。GRAS 的排名对象包括全球 3,000 多所大学，最终发布的榜单展示了 96 个国家和地区的 2,000 余所高校的近 2 万个学科点。 中国内地高校在 22 个学科排名世界第一，相比去年增加 1 个 。 其中清华大学有 7 个冠军学科，冠军学科数仅次于美国的哈佛大学（11 个），上海交通大学、四川大学、中国海洋大学等 15 所高校各有 1 个冠军学科。 中国高校冠军学科数量逐年增加，显示出中国高校的学科建设在服务国家战略和产业需求的牵引下正在加速突破，一批高校在各自的优势学科上正在实现从追赶者到全球引领者的转变。 美国大学在今年的软科世界一流学科排名中仍然保持领先，在 27 个学科占据榜首，上榜总次数达到 4,119 次。中国内地高校持续进步，在 22 个学科拔得头筹， 上榜总次数首次突破 4,000 次大关 ，达到 4,077 次，上榜高校数量达到 394 所。中国内地高校在各学科排名中的上榜总次数和上榜高校数量近 10 年来稳步提升。 哈佛大学在 11 个学科中夺…
items.summary_en: ShanghaiRanking released its 2026 Global Ranking of Academic Subjects, covering 57 subjects and more than 3,000 universities, with nearly 20,000 subject entries from over 2,000 institutions in 96 countries and regions. Mainland Chinese universities took first place in 22 subjects, up one from last year, with Tsinghua leading seven — second only to Harvard's 11. US universities topped 27 subjects, while mainland China's total appearances passed 4,000 for the first time, reaching 4,077 across 394 universities.
items.why_zh: 学科排名变化反映出中国高校在部分领域的全球竞争力持续上升。
items.why_en: Ranking shifts reflect Chinese universities' rising global competitiveness in key disciplines.

items.title_en: Zhipu raises another $5 billion, but placement price has halved in under two months
items.summary_zh: 再融资50亿美元， 智谱配售价2个月不到已腰斩 新浪网

items.title_zh: 联发科天玑 9600 Pro 旗舰芯片发布：2nm 工艺、4.55GHz 双超大核、120 帧光追手游
items.title_en: MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro Launched: 2nm Process, 4.55GHz Dual Prime Cores, 120fps Ray-Traced Gaming
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 15 日消息， 联发科天玑 9600 Pro 旗舰芯片 今日正式发布，定位旗舰 5G 智能体 AI 芯片，口号为“超冷劲，超智慧”。 IT之家从发布会现场获悉，天玑 9600 Pro 行业首批搭载 2nm 制程工艺，拥有 330 亿 + 晶体管，深度联合台积电共研。 天玑 9600 Pro 搭载 全新 Pro 架构 ，带来 CPU 天玑智算融合架构、GPU 天玑神经网络渲染架构、NPU 超性能 + 超能效双 NPU 架构、ISP 天玑智能影像架构。 CPU 天玑智算融合架构方面，天玑 9600 Pro 的 CPU 搭载： 2 x 超大核 C2-Ultra 4.55GHz 3 x 大核 C2-Pro 4.35GHz 3 x 大核 C2-Pro 3.1GHz 天玑 9600 Pro 的 CPU 单核性能相比天玑 9500 提升 17%，多核性能提升 15% ，AI 问答出词速度提升 40%。 天玑 9600 Pro 的 L2 缓存 相比天玑 9500 提升 21% ，L2 + L3 + 系统缓存容量达 34.5MB，支持 LPDDR6 内存和 UFS 5.0 闪存。 根据联发科官方数据，天玑 9600 Pro 在看 1080p 在线视频时的 功耗下降 48% ，续航能力更强。 NPU 方面，天玑 9600 Pro 运行 Always-On 端侧轻载模型的 功耗下降 4…
items.summary_en: MediaTek launched its Dimensity 9600 Pro flagship 5G AI chip, among the industry's first on a 2nm process with over 33 billion transistors, co-developed with TSMC. The CPU packs two 4.55GHz C2-Ultra prime cores and six C2-Pro cores, delivering 17% better single-core and 15% better multi-core performance than the Dimensity 9500 and 40% faster AI Q&A output. MediaTek claims 48% lower power for 1080p online video and a dual-NPU design for always-on on-device models.
items.why_zh: 2nm 制程与更强的端侧 NPU，意味着手机 AI 能力竞争进入新阶段。
items.why_en: 2nm silicon and stronger on-device NPUs push mobile AI competition into a new phase.

items.title_zh: CrowdStrike CEO 反对放缓前沿 AI 开发，称潘多拉魔盒已打开
items.title_en: CrowdStrike CEO Opposes Slowing Frontier AI Development, Says Pandora's Box Is Open
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 15 日消息，网络安全公司 CrowdStrike CEO 乔治 · 柯兹（George Kurtz）昨日接受 CNBC 采访时候，谈到 Anthropic CEO 达里奥 · 阿莫迪提出的“放缓前沿 AI 开发速度”想法。 乔治 · 柯兹反对阿莫迪的主张 。他认为开源权重模型和前沿 AI 已在现实世界流通，因此冻结先进 AI 开发并不会应对网络安全威胁。他对此比喻称：“ 潘多拉魔盒已经打开 ，无法关上。” 他还在采访中表示，Hugging Face 遭遇 AI 攻击后，各大公司的网安需要增加防护机制。他认为安防可以观察 AI 的行为，需要在 AI 运行时设置围栏，阻止它们实施有害行为。 IT之家注意到，乔治 · 柯兹认为，虽然 AI 智能体带来了重大安全风险，但政府如果对 AI 采取强硬监管措施，可能会让美国落后于竞争对手。与其放缓 AI 开发不如采取协同式 AI 安全方案，例如 Anthropic 的“玻璃之翼”。
items.summary_en: CrowdStrike CEO George Kurtz told CNBC he opposes Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's call to slow frontier AI development, arguing open-weight and frontier models are already circulating in the real world, so freezing development would not address cyber threats: "Pandora's box is already open." He said companies must add defenses after the Hugging Face AI attack, monitor AI behavior and set runtime guardrails, adding that heavy-handed government regulation could leave the US behind rivals.
items.why_zh: 凸显 AI 安全倡导者与产业界在“减速还是加速”上的分歧。
items.why_en: Highlights the split between AI safety advocates and industry leaders who argue slowing down would backfire.

items.title_en: Price hike reversed after 23 days: DeepSeek's IPO push runs into 'its own people'

items.summary_en: According to Sohu, DeepSeek reversed a price hike after just 23 days as it pushes toward an IPO and runs into issues involving 'its own people.' The episode links the company's pricing strategy with its capital-market ambitions, though details remain undisclosed.
items.why_zh: DeepSeek的IPO动向与价格策略调整相互交织，反映大模型商业化与资本化进程中的敏感性与不确定性。
items.why_en: DeepSeek's IPO moves and pricing adjustments are intertwined, reflecting the sensitivities and uncertainties in LLM commercialization and capital-market plans.

items.title_zh: 阶跃发布 StepAudio 3 系列语音大模型，拿下多个全球第一
items.title_en: StepFun Releases StepAudio 3 Series of Speech Models, Topping Global Rankings
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 15 日消息，今日阶跃正式发布 StepAudio3 系列模型，包括 StepAudio3Realtime、StepAudio3ASR、StepAudio3TTS、StepAudio3Gen 和 StepAudio3Music，其中多款模型在 Artificial Analysis 榜单中位列全球第一。以上五款模型，目前均已上线阶跃星辰开放平台。 官方称，StepAudio 3 系列分别面向几类核心场景：真人级语音生成、完整音频内容生成、实时语音交互、复杂场景语音理解和音乐创作。 IT之家附模型官方详细介绍如下： StepAudio 3 Realtime： 不仅“能打断”，更能理解、思考和行动 今天，越来越多 Realtime 语音产品已经支持全双工、打断和低延迟交互。真正拉开体验差距的，不只是“能不能同时听和说”，而是模型能否在一场持续发生的对话中，边听边理解、判断何时接话，同时完成推理和任务执行。 StepAudio 3 Realtime 围绕这一目标进一步提升实时交互能力，支持原生全双工实时对话。 在 Artificial Analysis Conversational Dynamics 榜单中，StepAudio 3 Realtime 以 98.9% 的综合得分排名全球第一，展现出领先的实时语音交互能力。这意味着模型不仅能够“听懂”和“回答”，更能够像真实…
items.summary_en: On September 15, StepFun launched the StepAudio 3 series of speech models, including Realtime, ASR, TTS, Gen and Music, all available on its open platform. The models target human-level speech generation, full audio content creation, real-time voice interaction, complex speech understanding and music creation. StepAudio 3 Realtime supports native full-duplex conversation and ranked first globally on Artificial Analysis' Conversational Dynamics leaderboard with a 98.9% composite score.
items.why_zh: 这表明中国厂商在实时语音交互与音频生成大模型上正加速追赶并争夺全球榜单领先位置。
items.why_en: It shows Chinese companies are accelerating in real-time voice interaction and audio generation models, competing for top spots on global leaderboards.

items.title_zh: 联发科天玑 9600 Pro 处理器采用台积电最新 2nm 制程，支持 LPDDR6 内存、UFS 5.0 闪存
items.title_en: MediaTek Unveils Dimensity 9600 Pro on TSMC 2nm, Supporting LPDDR6 and UFS 5.0
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 15 日消息，联发科今日召开旗舰新品发布会推出天玑 9600 Pro。官方在现场宣布， 这款处理器将采用台积电最新 2nm 制程工艺 。 据介绍， 天玑 9600 Pro 拥有 330 亿 + 晶体管 ，号称“业界超高”。联发科就先进制程深度联合台积电共研，带来设计工艺协同优化（IT之家注：DTCO）。 同时，该处理器还将采用“AI 原生架构”，使超大核功耗下降 37%、多核功耗下降 61%（对比天玑 9500）。 架构方面，该处理器拥有双超大核 C2-Ultra 4.55GHz、三大核 C2-Pro 4.35GHz 和三大核 C2-Pro 3.1GHz，配备 34.5MB L2+L3+ 系统缓存，率先支持 LPDDR6 内存、UFS 5.0 闪存。
items.summary_en: On September 15, MediaTek launched the Dimensity 9600 Pro, built on TSMC's latest 2nm process and featuring over 33 billion transistors. The chip uses an 'AI-native' architecture, cutting super-core power consumption by 37% and multi-core power by 61% versus the Dimensity 9500. It includes dual C2-Ultra cores at 4.55GHz, three C2-Pro cores at 4.35GHz and three at 3.1GHz, plus 34.5MB cache, and is first to support LPDDR6 memory and UFS 5.0 storage.
items.why_zh: 这代表移动芯片进入 2nm 时代，并将推动端侧 AI 与新一代内存、存储标准的落地。
items.why_en: It marks the move to 2nm mobile chips and is set to accelerate on-device AI and adoption of next-gen memory and storage standards.

Details such as terms, scope and timing were not disclosed. The move signals an attempt to build GUI-level collaboration between the assistant and third-party apps.
items.why_zh: 它关系到手机智能助手如何与第三方 App 协作，是 Agent 生态竞争在移动端的重要动向。
items.why_en: It matters because it shapes how mobile assistants collaborate with third-party apps, a key front in the mobile agent ecosystem race.

items.why_en: A major philanthropic foundation committing $1 billion to AI could shape how resources flow toward public-interest AI applications.

items.title_zh: 微软 CEO 纳德拉发布警告：AI 必须处于人类控制之下，支持更广泛的第三方测试
items.title_en: Microsoft CEO Nadella Warns AI Must Stay Under Human Control, Backs Broader Third-Party Testing
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 15 日消息，当地时间 9 月 14 日晚，微软 CEO 萨提亚 · 纳德拉在公司留言板发布内部备忘录，就 AI 行业是否发展过快发表看法。 他表示，AI 应保持在人类控制之下，支持更广泛的第三方测试，并警告公司必须花时间确保技术安全。“随着风险升高，人们应该需要多少时间就花多少时间。”“否则，你无论如何都会失去运营许可。” 此前，一些 AI 研究人员上周警告称，AI 技术可能杀死所有人。周末，Anthropic CEO 达里奥 · 阿莫代伊提议放缓 AI 开发，并表示公司会允许外部监控其模型进展。OpenAI CEO 萨姆 · 奥尔特曼同意第三方监控，并支持在必要时放缓部署，以确保对齐和安全。 微软周一还发布了 37 页的“人文主义”AI 模型行为准则草案。微软 AI 负责人穆斯塔法 · 苏莱曼写道：“我们长期在理论上担心的事情，已经变得非常真实。” 纳德拉在备忘录中提出三个重点领域。第一，明确设计目标：AI 必须处于人类控制之下，并广泛惠益社会。这意味着要打造一个能让开源和闭源模型都能繁荣的前沿生态，并在调整方向时谨慎把握节奏。 纳德拉将这种节奏类比为发布前的研发和测试。他表示，拥有更多外部或第三方测试和测试者是好事。随着风险升高，该花多少时间就花多少时间，否则最终将失去运营许可。 第二，对于客户，关键是确保他们控制自身独特和隐性知识，从而建立自己的持续学习循…
items.summary_en: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella said in an internal memo that AI must remain under human control and backed broader third-party testing, warning that companies must take as much time as needed to ensure safety or risk losing their operating licenses. The memo follows calls from Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman for slower development and external monitoring. Microsoft also released a 37-page draft of a "humanist" AI model behavior code, with AI chief Mustafa Suleyman saying long-theorized risks have become very real.
items.why_zh: 科技巨头CEO公开支持第三方监管与安全放缓，可能影响AI行业治理方向。
items.why_en: A tech giant CEO publicly backing third-party oversight and slower deployment could shape AI governance.

items.title_zh: 弗雷斯诺州立大学推出人工智能辅修专业
items.title_en: Fresno State launches new artificial intelligence minor
items.summary_zh: 据YourCentralValley.com报道，弗雷斯诺州立大学（Fresno State）宣布推出新的人工智能辅修专业。此举旨在将AI教育纳入学校课程体系，帮助学生掌握相关技能。目前报道未披露该辅修项目的具体课程设置、开课时间或招生规模等细节。随着AI技术在各行业加速渗透，越来越多高校开始增设AI相关专业或辅修方向，以满足学生和就业市场的需求。
items.summary_en: Fresno State launches new artificial intelligence minor YourCentralValley.com
items.why_zh: 高校增设AI辅修反映就业市场对AI技能的需求上升。
items.why_en: The new minor signals rising demand for AI skills in the job market.

items.summary_en: The Paper reports that AI large-model company Zhipu raised 70.7 billion yuan in two months, calling it a "cash-devouring beast." The headline highlights the scale of funding flowing into Chinese AI model startups. Further details on funding rounds and investors were not available.
items.why_zh: 巨额融资显示大模型赛道资本热度不减。
items.why_en: The huge raise underscores continued investor appetite for large-model startups.

The integration aims to bring Doubao's AI capabilities into Feishu's daily collaboration workflows. Details on features, availability, and launch timing have not been disclosed.
items.why_zh: 该合作显示AI办公助手正加速嵌入企业协作平台。
items.why_en: The partnership shows AI assistants becoming more embedded in enterprise collaboration platforms.

items.summary_en: An analysis piece from Chaoxi Net asks why Chinese large-model company Zhipu AI still needs to keep raising funds despite its existing model products and prior backing. The excerpt offers no figures on amounts, investors, or valuation; it centers on the capital dependence of large-model startups facing heavy compute, talent, and commercialization pressures.
items.why_zh: 大模型公司普遍面临高投入与商业化回报周期长的矛盾，这一讨论折射出行业对融资依赖度的普遍关切。
items.why_en: It reflects the sector-wide tension between heavy spending and slow commercialization that keeps large-model startups dependent on outside capital.

items.title_zh: 比尔 · 盖茨：中美大模型各有 4 家能够保持最先进水平，中国人形机器人运动会非常有意思
items.title_en: Bill Gates: China and the US Each Have Four Frontier Model Labs, and China's Humanoid Robot Games Are 'Very Interesting'
items.summary_zh: 今日， 盖茨基金会掏出 10 亿美元“砸”向人工智能 ，宣布将在未来两年花费重金，推动这项前沿技术不只为富人服务，也能帮最贫困的人改变命运。 在发布前夕，新浪科技与盖茨基金会主席比尔 · 盖茨展开了一场小范围对话。 在交流中，盖茨不仅高度评价“ 中国大模型表现非常出色 ”，剖析开源技术对于全球贫困地区的重要意义，还就外界关心的“数据中心耗电与环保焦虑”“AI 对就业市场的冲击”以及“中国人形机器人发展”等热点话题分享了观点。 他曾直言，商业资本容易忽略市场失灵与社会隐患，“AI 要么成为人类有史以来最厉害的平等促进工具，要么就会变成加剧不公的最大根源”。他同时呼吁，需建立全球管理框架，重新平衡劳动与资本的关系， AI 红利应惠及所有人，而不只流向少数富人 。 本次对话他还多次提到了中国。例如评价了中国刚刚举办的人形机器人运动会，他对赛事的成功表示惊叹，“ 我觉得非常有意思，而且办得非常好，仅仅是这场赛事本身，就令人难以置信 ”。同时还提及了中国的人工智能，认为其“表现非常出色”，预计中美前沿大模型的能力在六个月后会达到“今天的两倍以上”。 当新浪科技追问对中国开源大模型的具体评估时，他表示，“根据不同的衡量方式，中国和美国都分别有四家，甚至更多机构的模型，能够保持最先进水平。得分最高的模型与另外七个领先模型之间的差距，其实并不大。” 但其未透露四家大模型的具体名称 。 “呼吁部分技…
items.summary_en: The Gates Foundation is committing $1 billion to AI over the next two years, aiming to make the technology serve the poorest, not just the wealthy. In a conversation with Sina Tech, Bill Gates praised China's large models as 'outstanding,' predicted frontier model capabilities in China and the US will more than double within six months, and said each country has four or more labs at the frontier—without naming them. He also called China's humanoid robot games impressive and addressed AI's energy use, job disruption, and the need for global governance.
items.why_zh: 盖茨以十亿美元级投入和明确表态介入 AI 公益议程，其对中国与美国前沿模型格局的判断具有风向标意义。
items.why_en: Gates is putting a billion dollars and his own authority behind AI for the public good, and his read on the US-China frontier model landscape carries real weight.

items.why_en: AI phones are a key consumer gateway for large models, and reservation numbers offer an early read on market appetite.

items.title_zh: 岚图梦想家 9 车型 9 月 22 日上市：首搭虎踞 P 底盘，预售价 42.99 万元起
items.title_en: Voyah Dreamer 9 to Launch September 22 with New 'Huju P' Chassis, Pre-sales from 429,900 Yuan
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 15 日消息，在今日举行的岚图汽车虎踞智能底盘技术交流日上，岚图汽车宣布推出中国首个自主正向研发的旗舰 MPV 专属智能底盘 —— 虎踞 P 方案。 岚图汽车董事长卢放同时宣布，岚图梦想家 9 将于 9 月 22 日正式上市，首搭岚图虎踞 P 底盘。岚图梦想家 9 已于 9 月 5 日开启预售，共推出 5 款车型，预售价 42.99 万元至 52.99 万元。开启预售 48 小时小订突破 30000 台。 外观方面，新车配备 HUAWEI XPIXEL 双百万像素智慧投影大灯，前脸为扶摇直上龙鳞叠压式竖幅镀铬格栅，搭配鲲鹏展翅分体式贯穿大灯，内置北斗七星星芒灯光点阵。车身提供双拼色、定制腰线及多款式轮毂等选装方案。 车身侧面采用一体式鎏金饰条腰线，从前翼子板贯穿延伸至车尾。尺寸方面，长宽高分别为 5325/1998/1823mm，轴距 3200mm。车尾配备贯穿式尾灯组和车顶扰流板。 岚图梦想家 9 基于全系全域 L3 级架构设计打造，搭载 WEWA 世界模型及驾驭模式智能体，提供尊享、经济、舒适、高能四大专属驾乘模式。 内饰搭载鸿蒙座舱 HarmonySpace6。二排座椅支持多角度旋转、横滑、零重力、机械按摩功能。二三排配备 LC 自适应调光玻璃与分段式全景穹顶，双可拆卸扶手控制屏可控制座舱各项功能。 动力方面，全系配备 800V 高压平台。插混版全系匹配 6…
items.summary_en: Voyah unveiled the Huju P, described as China's first independently and forward-developed intelligent chassis dedicated to flagship MPVs, at a technical briefing. Chairman Lu Fang said the Voyah Dreamer 9 will launch on September 22 as the first model to use it. Pre-sales opened September 5 across five trims at 429,900–529,900 yuan, with over 30,000 orders in 48 hours. The MPV features Huawei XPIXEL projection headlights, an L3-capable architecture, the WEWA world model, HarmonySpace 6 cockpit, and an 800V platform.
items.why_zh: 自主正向研发的 MPV 专属智能底盘叠加 L3 级架构与华为、鸿蒙生态，显示出智能电动车竞争正转向底盘与 AI 智能体层面。
items.why_en: A self-developed intelligent MPV chassis plus L3 architecture and Huawei/HarmonyOS integration shows EV competition shifting toward chassis and AI-agent capabilities.

items.title_zh: MACE：用多智能体提升事件链接中的候选事件获取能力
items.title_en: Enhancing Event Candidate Acquisition for Event Linking
items.summary_zh: 事件链接任务旨在把文本中的事件提及与知识库条目对应起来，或判定其为知识库外事件。现有方法虽然架构各异，但候选事件获取环节仍会受到短小歧义提及、噪声论元以及检索价值不均的证据等因素削弱。论文提出 MACE，一种多智能体候选事件获取方法，在链接之前先对事件结构进行细化。MACE 使用按证据类型专门化的 LLM 智能体，分别获取时间、地点、参与者和事件类型等证据，再据此改进候选事件的召回与排序。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.13670v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Event linking associates event mentions in text with entries in a knowledge base (KB), or identifies them as out-of-KB events. Although existing methods use different architectures, candidate event acquisition can still be weakened by short ambiguous mentions, noisy arguments, and evidence that is unevenly useful for retrieval. We present MACE, a Multi-Agent Candidate Event acquisition method that refines event structure before linking. MACE uses evidence-specialized LLM agents to acquire time, location, participant, and event-type evidence, expo…
items.why_zh: 把事件链接的瓶颈定位在候选获取环节并用多智能体分工细化事件结构，为提升链接效果提供了可复用的思路。
items.why_en: It pinpoints candidate acquisition as the bottleneck in event linking and uses specialized agents to refine event structure, offering a reusable improvement path.

items.title_zh: JaxAHT：面向 Ad Hoc Teamwork 的 JAX 开源库
items.title_en: JaxAHT: A JAX-Based Library for Ad Hoc Teamwork
items.summary_zh: Ad Hoc Teamwork（AHT）研究如何设计能与事先未经协调的全新伙伴协同的智能体。该领域进展受制于三方面：AHT 研究全流程的计算成本过高、缺乏标准化的基准实现，以及缺少多样且经过验证的评估队友套件。为此，作者提出 JaxAHT——首个基于 JAX 的开源库，旨在加速并标准化 AHT 研究流程，并借助 JAX 的硬件加速能力提升训练与评估效率，同时补齐基准与队友套件的短板。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.13716v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ad Hoc Teamwork (AHT) addresses the challenge of designing agents capable of coordinating with novel partners without prior coordination. However, progress in the field is hindered by the prohibitive computational cost of the AHT research lifecycle, the lack of standardized benchmark implementations, and the absence of a diverse, validated evaluation teammate suite. In this work, we introduce JaxAHT, the first open-source, JAX-based library designed to accelerate and standardize the AHT research lifecycle. Leveraging JAX's hardware acceleration a…
items.why_zh: 标准化基准与高性能计算库能显著降低 AHT 研究门槛，推动这一协作智能方向更快积累可比结果。
items.why_en: Standardized benchmarks and a hardware-accelerated library lower the barrier to AHT research and enable more comparable results.

items.title_zh: 制图者与用图者：习得表征的认知归因边界
items.title_en: Map Users and Mapmakers: The Scope of Cognitive Attribution from Acquired Representations
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，一个系统可以通过习得某种表征来扩展其认知能力范围，但这种扩展并不等于它同时获得了产生该表征时所运用的能力。作者提出了一个用于界定这种能力扩展及其边界的框架，核心是一张五部分的归因表，区分了有效追踪、习得结构的应用、从显式规范中习得、从辨识性观察中习得，以及保持与复用。表中的每一类都对应一项正向能力承诺，以及一项需要额外论证的主张，从而为讨论“系统究竟具备了什么能力”提供更严谨的判据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.13879v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An acquired representation can enlarge a system's cognitive repertoire without transferring the capacities exercised in producing that representation. This paper develops a framework for specifying that enlargement and its limits. Its central contribution is a five-part attribution table distinguishing effective tracking, application of acquired structures, acquisition from explicit specifications, acquisition from identifying observations, and retention and reuse. Each entry identifies a positive capacity commitment and a further claim requiring…
items.why_zh: 在大模型能力评估中，清晰区分“拥有表征”与“具备能力”有助于避免对系统认知水平的过度归因。
items.why_en: Distinguishing possessing a representation from possessing a capacity helps prevent over-attribution when evaluating AI systems.

items.title_zh: OpenAI4S：以代码为行动，以科研会话为单位
items.title_en: OpenAl4S: Code as Action, Science as Sessions
items.summary_zh: AI 共同科学家有望加速计算型科研，但在长期研究过程中，工作流还必须保持可审查、可恢复和可复现，这要求持久化的计算状态与溯源信息。为此作者提出 OpenAI4S，一个开源科研智能体，其设计原则是“以代码为行动，以科研会话为单位”。该系统把持久化计算运行时与科研会话管理结合起来：编排通过结构化工具调用完成，而科学行动则被表示为一种可复现的计算单元，从而支持长周期研究中的可审查性与可复现性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.15096v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI co-scientists could accelerate computational research, but over a long-running study the workflow also has to stay inspectable, resumable and reproducible, which requires persistent computational state and provenance. Here we present OpenAI4S, an open-source scientific research agent built around the principle of \emph{Code as Action, Science as Sessions}. OpenAI4S combines a persistent computing runtime with research-session management: orchestration is handled through structured tool calls, while scientific actions are represented as complet…
items.why_zh: 把可复现性与溯源作为科研智能体的核心设计约束，是其走出演示、进入真实科研流程的关键。
items.why_en: Making reproducibility and provenance core design constraints is what lets research agents move beyond demos into real scientific workflows.

items.title_zh: 开源大模型在ESG领域检索增强生成任务中的实证评估
items.title_en: Empirical Evaluation of Open-Source Large Language Models for Retrieval-Augmented Generation in ESG Domain
items.summary_zh: 论文关注开源大模型在ESG（环境、社会与治理）领域的检索增强生成（RAG）表现。研究基于498份欧盟上市公司2010至2024年的真实ESG报告，构建了结构化评估框架与评测资源，并对7个参数规模从2B起的开源模型进行测试，目标是自动化提取关键绩效指标（KPI）。作者指出，开源LLM在专业ESG任务上的能力仍缺乏充分理解，该工作为相关选型与后续研究提供了基准依据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.15242v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) reporting is critical for corporate accountability, with Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) offering strong potential to automate KPI extraction. However, open-source LLM performance in domain-specific ESG tasks remains insufficiently understood. This paper evaluates open-source LLMs in ESG contexts using a structured framework and evaluation resource based on 498 real-world ESG reports from EU-listed companies (2010-2024). We evaluate seven open-source models (2B to 3…
items.why_zh: ESG报告合规需求旺盛，该研究首次系统给出开源模型在真实ESG语料上的RAG评测基准，为低成本自动化方案提供选型参考。
items.why_en: As ESG reporting demand grows, this study provides a much-needed benchmark for open-source models on real-world ESG data, guiding low-cost automation choices.

items.title_zh: 超越准确率：模板化文档抽取中视觉语言模型的鲁棒性、成本与治理权衡
items.title_en: Beyond Accuracy: Robustness, Cost, and Governance Trade-offs for Vision-Language Models in Templated Document Extraction
items.summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）被越来越多用于从商业文档中抽取结构化字段，但多数评测只报告干净基准上的准确率，难以为从业者按任务复杂度选型提供指导。该研究开展了一项以测量为基础的研究并开源代码，评测11套系统：3个商用系统、2个推理模型、5个预训练与微调的开源VLM，以及一个非LLM的OCR加正则基线，在750份合成支票留出集上打分。研究强调在准确率之外，还需权衡鲁棒性、成本与治理因素。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.15706v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to extract structured fields from business documents, yet most evaluations report accuracy on clean benchmarks and offer little guidance to practitioners choosing an approach for a given task complexity. We address this gap with a measurement-grounded study and an open-source release. Across eleven systems (three commercial, two reasoning, five open-source VLMs in pretrained and fine-tuned form, and a non-LLM OCR->regex floor) scored on a 750-document held-out pool of synthetic checks, fine-tuni…
items.why_zh: 它把文档抽取的评测从单一准确率扩展到鲁棒性、成本与治理维度，帮助企业按任务复杂度做出更务实的模型选型。
items.why_en: It reframes document-extraction evaluation beyond accuracy to include robustness, cost, and governance, helping practitioners make pragmatic model choices.

items.title_zh: 以MetaTool增强的ROS框架缓解开源LLM智能体的长程不稳定
items.title_en: Bridging Thought and Action: Taming Long-Horizon Instability in Open-Source LLM Agents with a MetaTool-Enhanced ROS Framework
items.summary_zh: 论文针对开源大模型在机器人智能体框架中长程推理不稳定、动作执行效率低的问题，提出一种改进的ROS-Agent架构。系统引入名为MetaTool的新中间机制，在动作执行之前强制进行结构化规划，以提升任务可靠性与执行效率。研究目标是让基于开源LLM的机器人系统更稳定高效，同时保留LLM带来的人机交互自然性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.13335v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled more natural human-robot interaction, but open-source models often exhibit unstable long-horizon reasoning and inefficient action execution when deployed in agentic robotic frameworks. This paper presents an enhanced ROS-Agent based architecture that improves task reliability and execution efficiency for agentic robotic systems using open-source LLMs. The proposed system introduces a novel intermediate mechanism, termed the MetaTool, which enforces structured planning prior to action execution. Given a…
items.why_zh: 长程不稳定是LLM驱动机器人落地的关键障碍，该工作用执行前结构化规划提供了可复用的工程思路。
items.why_en: Long-horizon instability is a key barrier to LLM-driven robotics, and structured pre-execution planning offers a reusable engineering fix.

items.title_zh: HarnessBandit：多框架智能体强化学习的可学习性与可迁移性联合调度
items.title_en: HarnessBandit: Joint Learnability-Transferability Scheduling for Multi-Harness Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.summary_zh: 语言模型智能体常通过不同“框架（harness）”部署，这些框架在系统提示、工具模式、控制循环与轨迹格式上各不相同，同一模型在不同接口下表现不均，因此对框架变化的鲁棒性成为重要目标。论文提出用多个框架训练共享策略，但这会带来调度问题：每个训练步应优先选择当前能提供有用学习信号的框架，同时保证该更新也能惠及其他框架。HarnessBandit据此对可学习性与可迁移性进行联合调度。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.13739v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Language-model agents are increasingly deployed through diverse harnesses that differ in system prompts, tool schemas, control loops, and trajectory formats. The same model can perform unevenly across these interfaces, making robustness to harness variation an important objective. A natural approach is to train a shared policy through multiple harnesses, but doing so introduces a scheduling problem: each training step should favor a harness that currently provides a useful learning signal while also producing an update that benefits the other h…
items.why_zh: 它把“跨框架鲁棒性”转化为可优化的调度问题，为智能体在异构接口下的稳定训练提供了新方法。
items.why_en: It turns cross-harness robustness into an optimizable scheduling problem, offering a new way to train agents stably across heterogeneous interfaces.

items.title_zh: 孟加拉语句子功能分类：语料构建、模型基准与可解释性
items.title_en: Bangla Sentence Function Classification: Corpus Development, Model Benchmarking, and Interpretability
items.summary_zh: 句子功能自动识别对对话系统、语音合成与机器翻译等下游NLP任务十分重要，但孟加拉语在该任务上的基准资源仍很有限。论文发布了一个包含10,000句孟加拉语的语料库，人工标注为陈述、疑问、祈使和感叹四个功能类别，四类分布接近均衡且标注质量较高。研究还开展了模型基准测试与可解释性分析，以填补该语言在此任务上的资源空白。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.13869v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Automatic sentence function identification is important for many downstream natural language processing (NLP) applications such as dialogue systems, text-to-speech synthesis, and machine translation. However, benchmark resources for Bangla sentence function classification remain limited. To mitigate this gap, this paper introduces a corpus of 10,000 Bangla sentences, manually annotated into four functional categories, namely declarative, interrogative, imperative, and exclamatory. The corpus is nearly balanced across the four classes, with high…
items.why_zh: 它为低资源语言孟加拉语补上了句子功能分类的标注语料与基准，有助于相关下游NLP应用。
items.why_en: It fills a resource gap for the low-resource Bangla language with an annotated corpus and benchmarks for sentence function classification.

items.title_zh: 科学人才正从“深度”转向“广度”吗？来自论文、知识输入、职业与团队的证据
items.title_en: Has Scientific Talent Shifted from Depth to Breadth?Evidence across Papers, Knowledge Inputs, Careers, and Teams
items.summary_zh: 生成式人工智能引发了科研训练与组织方式的核心疑问：研究是否正从深度专业化转向个体知识面的拓宽？作者基于2010至2025年六个领域的47,959篇文章、51,736篇可解析的被引作品，以及1,754位随机抽取作者按时间重建的发表历史展开考察。数据显示2010年至2022年间团队规模估计增长了37.3%，为这一转变提供了跨论文、知识输入、职业与团队的多维证据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.14425v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Generative artificial intelligence raises a central question for scientific training and organization. Is research shifting from deep specialization toward broad individual knowledge? We examine this proposition across papers, cited knowledge, contributor histories, and teams using 47,959 articles from six fields over 2010-2025, 51,736 resolved cited works, and chronologically reconstructed prior publication histories for 1,754 randomly selected index contributors. From 2010 to 2022, team size increased by an estimated 37.3% (95% confidence int…
items.why_zh: 它用大规模实证数据检验AI时代科研人才结构的变化，对科研训练与团队组织政策有直接参考价值。
items.why_en: It empirically tests whether AI-era scientific talent is shifting from depth to breadth, with direct implications for research training and team organization.

items.title_zh: Enemray：面向哈桑尼亚语的能力型语言模型
items.title_en: Enemray: Toward Capable Language Models for Hassaniya
items.summary_zh: 论文提出Enemray，一个以哈桑尼亚语（Hassaniya）为中心的语言模型，可实现该语言的通用交互。模型围绕“稳定性—可塑性”目标训练：在获得较强哈桑尼亚语语言与文化能力的同时，保留基座指令微调模型的一般推理、多语言、指令遵循与安全行为。其开发流程将语言习得与行为特化分离，并用单独构建的持续预训练语料让模型广泛接触自然哈桑尼亚语。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.14829v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce Enemray, a Hassaniya-centric language model that enables general-purpose interaction in Hassaniya. Enemray is trained around a stability--plasticity objective: acquire strong Hassaniya linguistic and cultural competence while preserving the general reasoning, multilingual, instruction-following, and safety behaviors of a capable instruction-tuned model. The development pipeline separates language acquisition from behavioral specialization. A separately assembled continual-pretraining corpus provides broad exposure to natural Hassan…
items.why_zh: 它为低资源语言哈桑尼亚语提供了兼顾能力与安全对齐的模型方案，展示了持续预训练与行为保持的平衡思路。
items.why_en: It offers a model recipe for the low-resource Hassaniya language that balances new-language competence with preserved general and safety behaviors.

items.title_zh: 当世界模型说谎：面向下游控制的潜世界模型后门攻击
items.title_en: When the World Lies: Backdoor Attacks on Latent World Models for Downstream Control
items.summary_zh: 预训练世界模型是一种学习型模拟器，将观测编码为潜状态并预测其在动作下如何演化，如今正像预训练编码器和语言模型一样被当作现成的动力学骨干复用于控制任务。论文揭示这种复用会打开供应链后门：仅控制所发布检查点的攻击者即可劫持下游控制器，而受害者完全在干净数据上训练与评估、从未见过触发条件。该攻击不编码显式触发器，因而更难被察觉。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.15781v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Pretrained world models, learned simulators that encode an observation into a latent state and predict how it evolves under actions, are beginning to be reused as off-the-shelf dynamics backbones for control, like pretrained encoders and language models are reused today. We show that this reuse opens a supply-chain backdoor: an adversary who controls only a released checkpoint can hijack the downstream controller, even though the victim trains and evaluates entirely on clean data and never sees the trigger. The attack encodes no explicit trigge…
items.why_zh: 它首次揭示世界模型复用带来的供应链安全风险，提醒下游控制系统的使用者警惕不可信检查点。
items.why_en: It exposes a supply-chain security risk in reusing pretrained world models, warning downstream control users about untrusted checkpoints.

items.title_zh: vla-eval：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的统一评测框架
items.title_en: vla-eval: A Unified Evaluation Harness for Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型如今常在多个仿真基准上接受评测，但每接入一个新基准，团队都要处理互不兼容的依赖、匹配定义不清的评测协议，并逆向还原未文档化的预处理流程。这种负担随模型与基准数量同步增长，使全面评测对多数团队而言难以实现。为此研究者提出 vla-eval，一个开源评测框架，通过将模型推理与基准特定逻辑解耦，消除逐基准的接入开销。该工作以 arXiv 替换版形式发布。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.13966v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are increasingly evaluated across multiple simulation benchmarks, yet adding each benchmark to an evaluation pipeline requires resolving incompatible dependencies, matching underspecified evaluation protocols, and reverse-engineering undocumented preprocessing. This burden scales with the number of models and benchmarks, making comprehensive evaluation impractical for most teams. We present vla-eval, an open-source evaluation harness that eliminates this per-benchmark cost by decoupling model inference from…
items.why_zh: 统一的评测框架有望降低 VLA 研究中的重复工程负担，让不同模型与基准之间的比较更可复现。
items.why_en: A unified harness could cut duplicated engineering effort in VLA research and make comparisons across models and benchmarks more reproducible.

items.title_zh: 从经验中进化：面向分操作表格问答的技能增强表格图推理
items.title_en: Evolving from Lessons: Skill-Augmented Table Graph Reasoning for Operation-wise Table Question Answering
items.summary_zh: 表格问答（TableQA）旨在基于表格推理回答用户提问，但现有研究把所有问题一视同仁、只用总体准确率评估，掩盖了一个关键事实：大语言模型擅长简单查表，却在聚合、算术等复杂操作上表现不佳。为揭示这种差异，作者提出“分操作表格问答”（Operation-wise TableQA）任务，给出细粒度的问题分类，并发布 WikiTQ-ow 与 TabFact-ow 两个评测数据集。该文以 arXiv 替换版形式发布，并针对现有方法的建模瓶颈展开讨论。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.22633v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Table Question Answering (TableQA) aims to reason over tables to answer user queries. Existing research treats all questions uniformly and evaluates solely through overall accuracy, obscuring a critical reality that LLMs excel at simple lookups yet struggle with complex operations like aggregation and arithmetic. To reveal this disparity, we introduce a novel \emph{Operation-wise TableQA} task with a fine-grained question taxonomy and release two datasets named WikiTQ-ow and TabFact-ow for evaluation. As for modeling bottlenecks, existing met…
items.why_zh: 按操作类型拆分评测能暴露 LLM 在表格推理中的具体短板，推动更有针对性的方法改进。
items.why_en: Breaking evaluation down by operation type exposes where LLMs actually fail at table reasoning, guiding more targeted method design.

items.title_zh: Benchmark Radar：AI 基准与评测的活数据库与搜索引擎
items.title_en: Benchmark Radar: A Living Database and Search Engine for AI Benchmarks and Evaluation
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型及其他 AI 系统的基准研究者与开发者，需要找到相关评测、定位基准数据集与代码，并理解所报告分数背后的实验设置。为此作者提出 Benchmark Radar，一个用于检索和发现 AI 基准的“活数据库”与搜索引擎。其覆盖范围包括 LLM 评测、智能体与工具使用、编程、推理、安全以及特定领域评测。系统结合每日对基准论文、代码仓库、数据集与发布的发现与索引，帮助用户持续跟踪最新评测资源。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11115v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Benchmark researchers and developers of large language models (LLMs) and other AI systems need to find relevant evaluations, locate their benchmark datasets and code, and understand the settings behind reported scores. We present Benchmark Radar, a living database and search engine for retrieval and discovery of AI benchmarks, covering LLM evaluation, agentic and tool-use benchmarks, coding, reasoning, safety, and domain-specific evaluations. The system combines daily discovery of benchmark papers, repositories, datasets, and releases with a…
items.why_zh: 评测资源分散且更新迅速，统一的检索入口有助于研究者快速定位合适的基准并读懂分数背后的设置。
items.why_en: Evaluation resources are scattered and fast-moving, so a unified discovery layer helps researchers find suitable benchmarks and understand the settings behind reported scores.

items.title_zh: SemVerBench：评测 LLM 对版本约束解析语义的理解
items.title_en: SemVerBench: Benchmarking LLM Comprehension of Version-Constraint Resolution Semantics
items.summary_zh: LLM 编程智能体经常要判断某个版本是否满足 ^1.2.3 或 >=2.0 这类约束。SemVerBench 专门评测模型对版本约束解析语义的理解：Cargo 的语义陷阱（如 1.2 实为 >=1.3.0）几乎让所有模型失手，失败率接近 60%；标准 PEP 440 前缀匹配虽被普遍掌握，但在补零与 post-release 等边界情形上，GPT-5.1 在 26 题中全军覆没，而 Claude 保持在 97–100%（在 67 题经 oracle 校验的集合上验证）。Opus 显著优于其他所有模型，Sonnet 也优于 OpenAI 系列模型（McNemar 检验）。作者认为这类失败更像是“激活／应用”层面的差距，而非知识缺失。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11180v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Large language model (LLM) coding agents constantly decide whether a version satisfies a constraint such as ^1.2.3 or >=2.0, 1.2 means >=1.3.0) traps every model on Cargo (near 60%), and although standard PEP 440 prefix matching is universal, on zero-pad/post-release corner cases GPT-5.1 collapses (0/26) while Claude stays at 97-100% (verified on a 67-item oracle-validated set). Opus significantly outperforms all other models, and Sonnet outperforms the OpenAI models (McNemar). The failures look more like an activation/application gap than a…
items.why_zh: 版本约束判断是依赖管理与自动化编程的关键环节，其系统性失败会直接影响 AI 编程智能体的可靠性。
items.why_en: Version-constraint resolution is central to dependency management and autonomous coding, so systematic failures directly limit the reliability of AI coding agents.

items.title_zh: 视觉-语言模型中的情境依赖可供性报告
items.title_en: Context-Dependent Affordance Reports in Vision-Language Models
items.summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型在不同人格提示下会给出不同的物体与用途描述，但仅凭重叠度低并不能证明存在“可供性”效应。作者复查了此前一项使用七种提示的研究，并加入匹配问题的对照实验。在历史 Qwen 试点数据中，3213 条可解析回答里有 363 条包含空的物体列表，这些空回答影响了 9244 组比较中的 2037 组，因为实现会给所有受影响的配对赋予零词汇重叠。在只保留非空报告后，汇总的词级 Jaccard 从 0.095 上升到 0.121。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.04419v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Vision-language models produce different object and use descriptions under different persona prompts, but low overlap alone does not identify an affordance effect. We audit an earlier seven-prompt study and add matched-question controls. In the historical Qwen pilot, 363 of 3,213 parsed responses contain empty object lists. These affect 2,037 of 9,244 comparisons, with the implementation assigning zero lexical overlap to every affected pair. Conditioning on nonempty reports raises pooled word Jaccard from 0.095 to 0.121 and sentence cos…
items.why_zh: 该研究指出了评测多模态模型提示敏感性时容易被忽视的数据处理陷阱，提醒相关结论需要更严谨的对照验证。
items.why_en: It exposes a data-handling pitfall in measuring prompt sensitivity of multimodal models, calling for more rigorous controls before drawing conclusions.

items.title_zh: 面向聚变能源与科学应用的人在环元贝叶斯优化
items.title_en: Human-in-the-Loop Meta Bayesian Optimization for Fusion Energy and Scientific Applications
items.summary_zh: 惯性约束聚变（ICF）被视为可持续、近乎无限的清洁能源方案，但受制于极高的实验成本与有限的实验机会。作者提出人在环元贝叶斯优化（HL-MBO）框架，将专家知识与小样本、不确定性感知的机器学习结合，以加速数据稀缺且高风险的科研领域中的发现。HL-MBO 引入了元学习的代理模型，并配合由专家知识引导的采集函数。该文以 arXiv 替换版（跨领域）形式发布。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.00068v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Inertial Confinement Fusion (ICF) holds transformative promise for sustainable, near-limitless clean energy, yet remains constrained by prohibitively high costs and limited experimental opportunities. This paper presents Human-in-the-Loop Meta Bayesian Optimization (HL-MBO), a framework that integrates expert knowledge with few-shot, uncertainty-aware machine learning to accelerate discovery in data-scarce, high-stakes scientific domains. HL-MBO introduces a meta-learned surrogate model with an expert-informed acquisition function to re…
items.why_zh: 在实验机会极其稀缺的高风险科学领域，把专家知识嵌入优化循环有望显著提升每次实验的信息产出。
items.why_en: In high-stakes science where experiments are scarce, embedding expert knowledge in the optimization loop can sharply raise the value of each experiment.

items.title_zh: 自演化 LLM 的算力分配：从深度-广度到多臂老虎机
items.title_en: Compute Allocation for Self-Evolving LLMs: From Depth-Breadth to Multi-Armed Bandits
items.summary_zh: LLM 引导的演化搜索（Evolve 系统）在数学与组合任务上已达到领先水平，但多数系统只报告多次运行中的最好结果，未记录运行间的分布。作者追问：固定的 LLM 调用预算应如何分配，单次运行又有多大把握达到所报告的数字。他们在五个模型、三项任务上扫描“深度-广度”网格，识别出两条经验规律，其中包括一条“适应度-算力包络”，沿该包络不同能力的排序大体消失。论文进一步从深度-广度问题走向多臂老虎机视角的算力分配。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.29268v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: LLM-guided evolutionary search (Evolve systems) has reached state-of-the-art results on mathematical and combinatorial tasks, yet most existing systems report only the best of many runs and leave the run-to-run distribution undocumented. We ask how a fixed budget of LLM calls should be allocated, and how reliably a single run reaches the reported numbers. Sweeping the depth-breadth grid over five models and three tasks, we identify two empirical regularities: a fitness-compute envelope along which capability ordering largely collapses w…
items.why_zh: 揭示算力分配与结果分布的规律，有助于让自演化 LLM 的评测更可信、资源使用更高效。
items.why_en: Understanding how budget allocation shapes outcomes makes self-evolving LLM evaluation more trustworthy and compute use more efficient.

items.title_zh: MameLoshnLM：意第绪语语言模型与评测基准
items.title_en: MameLoshnLM: Yiddish Language Model and Evaluation Benchmark
items.summary_zh: 作者发布 MameLoshnLM，这是首个专为意第绪语构建的开源 80 亿参数语言模型。意第绪语拥有丰富的文本传统，但数字资源有限、可靠的评测资源稀缺，制约了该语言建模的进展；现有多语种语料与基准往往只是该语言的粗糙替代品，含有大量噪声、机器翻译与错误分类的文本。为填补这些空白，作者推出了高质量的意第绪语预训练语料 Oytser，并配套评测基准。该文以 arXiv 替换版（跨领域）形式发布。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.05850v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present MameLoshnLM, the first open-source 8B-parameter language model built specifically for Yiddish. Despite Yiddish's rich textual tradition, its limited digital presence and the scarcity of reliable evaluation resources have constrained progress in Yiddish language modeling. Existing multilingual corpora and benchmarks are often poor proxies for the language, containing substantial amounts of noisy, machine-translated, and misclassified text. We address these gaps by introducing Oytser, a high-quality Yiddish pretraining corpus t…
items.why_zh: 为低资源语言提供专门模型、干净语料与评测基准，可推动意第绪语 NLP 摆脱嘈杂的多语种替代资源。
items.why_en: A dedicated model, clean corpus and benchmark give Yiddish NLP a foundation beyond noisy multilingual proxy data.

items.title_zh: 表格基础模型还需要特征工程吗？
items.title_en: Do Tabular Foundation Models Still Need Feature Engineering?
items.summary_zh: 一篇新论文提出并检验了一个当下颇具现实意义的问题：随着表格基础模型（TFM）日益强大，人工特征构造是否还重要。研究者在 TabArena 的基准数据集上，对两大主流 TFM 家族的多个版本进行了受控实验，系统测试了多种现有特征工程技术，考察这些预处理手段在不同模型版本上的表现差异。摘要指出实验结果呈现出某种一致的模式，但原文摘要在关键结论处截断，因此具体结论方向尚无法确定。这项工作的价值在于为“特征工程在预训练表格模型时代是否仍有必要”提供了可复现的实证参照。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.13202v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Feature engineering has long been a cornerstone of tabular machine learning. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are pretrained on a wide range of tabular datasets and applied via in-context learning. Their rise raises a natural question: does manual feature construction still matter as these models become more capable? To answer this, we perform a controlled study across several versions of two major TFM families, testing a wide range of existing feature engineering techniques on benchmark datasets from TabArena. We find a consistent pattern: featu…
items.why_zh: 它直接关系到数据科学家在表格任务上是否还应投入大量精力做特征工程。
items.why_en: It directly informs whether practitioners still need to invest in manual feature engineering for tabular tasks.

items.title_zh: 面向遗忘型对手的多臂老虎机最优切换遗憾界
items.title_en: Toward Optimal Switching Regret for Multi-Armed Bandits with Oblivious Adversary
items.summary_zh: 论文研究对抗性多臂老虎机中的“切换遗憾”：学习者所对标的臂序列最多变化 S 次。已知 S 时，Auer 等人（2002）早已给出最优的期望遗憾上界，但在 S 未知的情形下，Marinov 与 Zimmert（2021）证明在自适应对手面前无法达到该保证。本文证明，只需一个算法即可在遗忘型对手（oblivious adversary）下对每个 S 都达到同样量级的期望遗憾，从而在对手强度上找到了一条可行边界。结果厘清了“未知切换次数”这一经典难题中可实现与不可实现之间的分界。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.13547v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study switching regret in adversarial multi-armed bandits, where the learner competes with an arm sequence that changes at most $S$ times. When $S$ is known, an optimal expected regret of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{(S+1)KT})$ is obtainable [Auer et al., 2002]. However, when $S$ is unknown, Marinov and Zimmert [2021] show that this guarantee is impossible under an adaptive adversary. In this paper, we show that a single algorithm achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{(S+1)KT})$ expected regret for every $S$ against an oblivious adversary,…
items.why_zh: 它在“未知切换次数”这一长期开放的设定下划出了可实现与不可实现之间的精确边界。
items.why_en: It pins down the exact boundary between achievable and impossible guarantees in the long-open unknown-switching setting.

items.title_zh: 贪心采样也能探索：不依赖 Eluder 维度的 KL 正则化上下文老虎机
items.title_en: When Greedy Sampling Explores: KL-Regularized Contextual Bandits without Eluder-Dimension Dependence
items.summary_zh: 论文研究 KL 正则化上下文老虎机，覆盖奖励反馈与偏好反馈两种情形。作者证明，直接从未知奖励所诱导的 Gibbs 策略中采样的简单贪心算法，即可取得对数级遗憾，而无需显式依赖 Eluder 维度——这一维度通常决定此类问题的复杂度。研究进一步把结论推广到偏好反馈下的通用偏好模型与 Bradley–Terry 模型，并改进了已有的依赖维度的保证。该结果说明，在正则化框架下“纯利用式”采样本身就隐含了足够的探索能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.13564v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study KL-regularized contextual bandits under both reward and preference feedback. We show that greedy sampling can achieve logarithmic regret without explicit dependence on the eluder dimension. For reward feedback, we establish an eluder-dimension-independent regret bound for a simple greedy algorithm that directly samples from the Gibbs policy induced by the estimated reward. We further extend this result to preference feedback under both the general preference and Bradley--Terry models, while also sharpening existing dimension-dependent gu…
items.why_zh: 它表明在正则化设定下，最简单的贪心采样无需额外探索机制也能达到近最优遗憾。
items.why_en: It shows that under regularization, plain greedy sampling needs no extra exploration machinery to approach optimal regret.

items.title_zh: 用分片非退化与在位回退为模型升级做认证
items.title_en: Certifying Model Upgrades with Slice-Wise Non-Regression and Incumbent Fallback
items.summary_zh: 论文关注一个常见却棘手的问题：模型更新可能提升总体指标，却损害某个对下游用户至关重要的数据分片。作者研究在给定“非退化容忍度”下如何相对保留的在位模型选择检查点，并强调“未能检测到损害”与“认证非劣”是两回事——在评估噪声下，前者很可能放行有害更新。他们提出一套可复现的发布流程，将候选搜索与独立的配对评估分离，一旦认证失败就精确返回原在位模型。这为模型上线提供了更可控的风险保障机制。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.13714v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An updated model can improve an aggregate metric while degrading a slice that matters to a downstream user. We study checkpoint selection subject to non-regression tolerances relative to a retained incumbent. The central distinction is between failing to detect harm and certifying non-inferiority: the former can release harmful updates with high probability when evaluation is noisy. We give a reproducible release procedure that separates candidate search from independent, paired evaluation and returns the exact incumbent when certification fails.…
items.why_zh: 它把“升级是否伤害关键子群”从主观判断变成可认证、可回退的发布流程。
items.why_en: It turns 'does this upgrade harm a key subgroup?' into a certifiable release procedure with a safe fallback.

items.title_zh: 推理能提升大模型的心理深度吗？取决于谁来评判
items.title_en: Does Reasoning Improve Psychological Depth in Large Language Models? It Depends on Who's Judging
items.summary_zh: 论文指出现有 LLM-as-a-Judge 评估的一个失效模式：评判模型在其开发集上与人类评分的相关性，并不能保证在输出水平接近、人类偏好主观的场景下仍然有效。作者以短篇小说的“心理深度”为切入点，让七位人类读者与一个 LLM 评委集成（在原标量心理深度数据集上相关系数为 0.646）共同评估 60 组经过盲测、提示词匹配的故事对，涉及 GPT-5 对 GPT-4o、DeepSeek-R1 对另一个模型的比较。研究提示，推理能力的提升是否带来更深的人物心理描写，很大程度上取决于评判者的选择。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.13773v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge evaluators are increasingly used to score open-ended generation, yet a judge's correlation with human ratings on its development set may not guarantee valid measurement when outputs are closely matched and human preferences are subjective. We study this failure mode through psychological depth in short stories. Seven human readers and an LLM-judge ensemble selected on the original scalar Psychological Depth Scale dataset ($\rho = 0.646$) evaluated 60 blinded, prompt-matched story pairs from GPT-5 vs.\ GPT-4o and DeepSeek-R1 vs.\ De…
items.why_zh: 它警示以 LLM 评委替代人类评估时，细粒度、主观性强的能力维度可能被系统性误判。
items.why_en: It warns that LLM judges can systematically misjudge fine-grained, subjective quality dimensions.

items.title_zh: 继承来的注意力头：音频语言模型靠文本主干定位说话人
items.title_en: Inherited Heads: Audio language models track speakers with their text backbone's attention, and an attention-mass ranking retrieves a different set
items.summary_zh: 论文发现音频语言模型在“六位说话人中谁说了什么”这类任务上表现极差，正确率仅 6% 到 16%，低于 16.7% 的随机猜测水平。令人意外的是，只需在约一百个注意力头的 logits 上加入固定偏置——不到模型总头数的十分之一、且完全无需训练——就能让模型以 90.7% 到 99.0% 的概率指向指定的说话人。作者进一步指出，这些头大多并非音频专用：在纯文本语言模型或其同族已发布模型上，用文字版本任务排序，也能检索到另一组不同的头。这说明音频能力在很大程度上继承了文本主干的注意力结构。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.14174v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Asked to describe what one of six speakers in a recording talks about, audio language models describe the right one on 6 to 16% of trials, below the 16.7% a guess would give. Adding a fixed bias to the attention logits of a hundred heads, under a tenth of the model's and with no training, redirects the description to whichever speaker we choose, on 90.7% to 99.0% of trials. Those heads are largely not specific to audio. Rank the text-only language model an audio model was built from, or a released model of the same family, on a written version of…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了音频多模态能力如何继承自文本主干的注意力回路，并给出无需训练的可控干预手段。
items.why_en: It reveals how audio capabilities are inherited from the text backbone's attention circuits, and offers a training-free control knob.

items.title_zh: CoArena：在真实时间内评测计算机使用与多智能体系统
items.title_en: CoArena: Evaluating Computer-Use and Multi-Agent Systems in Real Time
items.summary_zh: 论文指出静态基准的固有缺陷：任务集在发布时固定、每个系统只测一次，虽然可复现，却会随任务老化、泄漏进训练语料，也无法跟上用户使用智能体的真实方式。为此作者提出 CoArena，直接测量真实使用：由真实用户提交任务，两个系统——可以是单一模型或同一工具接口背后的多智能体流水线——在完全相同的沙盒桌面中并发执行同一任务，再由用户对两个结果做出评判。这种“实时竞技场”式评测有望缓解基准漂移与数据污染问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.14239v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Static benchmarks for computer-use agents fix a task set at release and score every system against it once. That makes them reproducible, and it lets them drift from what they should measure: a fixed task set ages, leaks into training corpora, and cannot follow how people actually use agents from week to week. CoArena measures use directly. Real users submit tasks; two systems, each a single model or a multi-agent pipeline behind the same tool interface, execute the same task concurrently in identical sandboxed desktops; users judge the two outco…
items.why_zh: 它用真实用户任务与并发对局取代固定题库，直面基准老化与数据污染两大痛点。
items.why_en: It replaces frozen task sets with live user tasks and head-to-head runs, addressing benchmark aging and contamination.

items.title_zh: 马尔可夫 α-势博弈中去中心化学习的高概率 Nash 遗憾
items.title_en: High-Probability Nash Regret for Decentralized Learning in Markov $\alpha$-Potential Games: Episodic and Fully Online Asynchronous Algorithms with Applications to Markov Congestion Games
items.summary_zh: 论文研究无限时域折扣马尔可夫博弈在 bandit 反馈下的去中心化纳什均衡学习，聚焦马尔可夫 α-势博弈。作者提出 KL 投影的自然策略梯度（NPG）算法，覆盖两种设定：采样期间冻结策略的分幕式设定，以及完全在线设定——每个玩家每步只获得一个实际成本样本，并沿连续轨迹异步更新策略。研究给出了有限时间、高概率的纳什均衡遗憾界，并把结果应用于马尔可夫拥塞博弈。这类结果对多智能体系统的收敛可靠性具有理论意义。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.14959v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study decentralized learning of Nash equilibria (NE) in infinite-horizon discounted Markov games under bandit feedback, focusing on Markov $\alpha$-potential games. We develop KL-projected natural policy gradient (NPG) algorithms in two settings: an episodic setting with frozen policies during sampling and a fully online setting in which players receive a single realized cost sample per time step and update their policies asynchronously along a continuing trajectory. We establish finite-time high-probability NE regret bounds of order $\widetil…
items.why_zh: 它为玩家只能异步、有限反馈的多智能体系统提供了理论上的收敛保证。
items.why_en: It provides convergence guarantees for multi-agent systems where players update asynchronously from limited feedback.

items.title_zh: 面向隐私的个性化联邦学习：紧凑适配与变长高斯通信
items.title_en: Privacy-Aligned Personalized Federated Learning with Compact Adaptation and Variable-Length Gaussian Communication
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文指出，记录级差分隐私在个性化联邦学习中会造成结构性错配：客户端之间的差异本身是低维的，但训练过程却要反复释放高维更新，隐私保护因此与模型表达不匹配。作者的解决思路是只释放一次私有的客户端上下文，把后续反复进行的适配限制在固定的系数空间内；其因子化生成器还引入一种自适应的优化几何结构，用于重塑带噪更新。论文提到受控消融实验支持该设计（公开摘要在此处被截断，未给出完整结果）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.15950v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Record-level differential privacy exposes a structural misalignment in personalized federated learning when client-specific variation is low-dimensional while training repeatedly releases high-dimensional updates. In this paper, we address this misalignment by releasing a private client context once and confining repeated adaptation to a fixed coefficient space. Beyond dimensionality reduction, the factorized generator induces an adaptive optimization geometry that reshapes noisy updates, and controlled ablations show that most of its private-tra…
items.why_zh: 它试图解决联邦学习中“隐私保护需求”与“高维反复更新”之间的根本矛盾，为个性化模型的隐私部署提供新思路。
items.why_en: It tackles the fundamental tension between privacy requirements and repeated high-dimensional updates in federated learning, offering a new route to privately deployed personalized models.

items.title_zh: 为凸优化生成定制 Rust 求解器的新工具
items.title_en: Generation of Custom Solvers in Rust for Convex Optimization
items.summary_zh: 研究者发布开源工具 cvxgenrust，可为在 CVXPY 中建模的一类参数化凸优化问题自动生成定制 Rust 代码。该工具先对问题族做规范化，提取仿射映射并转换为 Clarabel 锥规划数据，再生成一个专用 Rust crate，在运行时更新参数并原生调用 Clarabel 求解。生成的求解器还能暴露给 Python，并注册为 CVXPY 的自定义求解器。据摘要，其代码生成器支持的凸优化问题范围较广，可覆盖至半定规划。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.13875v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce cvxgenrust, an open-source tool for generating custom Rust code that solves families of parameterized convex optimization problems modeled in CVXPY. cvxgenrust canonicalizes a problem family, extracts affine maps to Clarabel cone-program data, and generates a specialized Rust crate that updates parameters and calls Clarabel natively at runtime. The generated solver can also be exposed to Python and registered as a custom CVXPY solver. Our code generator supports a wide range of convex optimization problems up to semidefinite progra…
items.why_zh: 它把建模层的便捷性与 Rust 运行时的高性能结合起来，降低为特定问题生成专用求解器的门槛。
items.why_en: It combines the convenience of a modeling layer with Rust's runtime performance, lowering the barrier to producing specialized solvers for specific problem families.

items.title_zh: AI 辅助的工作流优化与自动化
items.title_en: AI Assisted Workflow Optimization and Automation
items.summary_zh: 在数字化转型与监管趋严的背景下，企业合规工作对效率和准确度提出了更高要求。研究指出，辅助性合规流程因事务性强、重复度高，已成为优化合规体系的重要切入点。论文围绕这类流程的特征，梳理其结构组成与组织机制，并提出结合流程再造、系统建模与技术手段的优化路径（公开摘要在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.14323v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Against the backdrop of digital transformation and stricter regulation, enterprise compliance work demands higher efficiency and accuracy. The auxiliary compliance process has become an important entry point for optimizing the compliance system due to its strong transactional nature and high degree of repetition. This study focuses on the process characteristics of auxiliary compliance work, sorts out its structural composition and organizational mechanism, proposes an optimization path with process reengineering, system modeling, and technolog…
items.why_zh: 它把 AI 自动化的落点放在高频重复的合规辅助流程上，为企业降本增效提供了具体切入点。
items.why_en: It targets high-frequency, repetitive auxiliary compliance work as the entry point for AI automation, offering a concrete route to enterprise efficiency gains.

items.title_zh: 面向真实场景的持续学习新范式 RealCL 与 CLARE 方法
items.title_en: Realistic Continual Learning Approach using Pre-trained Models
items.summary_zh: 持续学习研究模型在获得新任务时保留已有知识的能力，核心难题是灾难性遗忘——模型学习新任务后会丢失此前掌握的本领。论文指出，现有实验设置多依赖理想化的类增量学习场景，与真实情况存在差距。为此作者提出“真实持续学习”（RealCL）范式，其中各任务间的类别分布是随机的；同时提出 CLARE（基于预训练模型的持续学习方法）以应对该设定。摘要在此处被截断，未给出完整的方法细节与实验结果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2404.07729v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Continual learning (CL) evaluates adaptability in learning solutions to retain knowledge. Our research addresses the challenge of catastrophic forgetting, where models lose proficiency in previously learned tasks as they acquire new ones. While numerous solutions have been proposed, existing experimental setups often rely on idealized class-incremental learning scenarios. We introduce Realistic Continual Learning (RealCL), a novel CL paradigm where class distributions across tasks are random. We also present CLARE (Continual Learning Approach…
items.why_zh: 它质疑了持续学习评测中过于理想的假设，推动研究更贴近真实的数据分布变化。
items.why_en: It challenges idealized assumptions in continual-learning benchmarks and pushes evaluation toward more realistic data distributions.

items.title_zh: 耦合缩放：神经缩放定律的表征可达性框架
items.title_en: Coupled Scaling: A Representational Accessibility Framework for Neural Scaling Laws
items.summary_zh: 论文提出一个核心问题：在同一任务、同一资源协议下训练的两个学习系统，何时应当共享相同的缩放速率，何时速率又应当不同。作者以“表征可达性”作答，即特定架构—优化系统能够触及的任务相关几何结构，以及这种几何如何随资源增长而被获取。在正交模型中，不受支持的目标能量决定渐近下界，而未被获取的受支持能量决定有限预算下的残差；当获取过程可以跳过高价值方向时，缩放行为会随之改变。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03533v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We ask when two learning systems trained on the same task under a common resource protocol should share a scaling rate and when their rates should differ. Coupled Scaling answers this through representational accessibility: the task-relevant geometry that a specified architecture-optimization system can reach and how that geometry is acquired as resources grow. In an orthogonal model, unsupported target energy sets the asymptotic floor, while unacquired supported energy sets the finite-budget residual. When acquisition can skip high-value dir…
items.why_zh: 它为神经缩放定律提供了统一的解释框架，有助于判断不同架构与优化方法何时会呈现相同或不同的缩放行为。
items.why_en: It offers a unifying framework for neural scaling laws, helping predict when different architectures and optimizers will scale at the same or different rates.

items.title_zh: Waymo 自动驾驶出租车商业服务目标 2027 年正式登陆日本东京市场
items.title_en: Waymo Targets 2027 Launch of Commercial Robotaxi Service in Tokyo
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 15 日消息，Alphabet 旗下自动驾驶企业 Waymo 当地时间 14 日宣布， 其 Robotaxi 商业服务目标于 2027 年正式在日本东京市场全面推出 ，具体时间表取决于日本国家与地方政府的监管批准。 Waymo 早在 2024 年 12 月就宣布了进军日本的计划，并从 2025 年开始与出租车企业日本交通、出行平台 GO 合作进行有监督的自动驾驶实地测试训练。该服务将进一步完善东京交通网络，助力日本应对交通行业的人口老龄化和未来劳动力短缺问题。 Waymo 在东京的 Robotaxi 商业部署将从少量车辆开始 ， 随后逐步扩展至约 100 辆 ，覆盖东京的主要街区。
items.summary_en: Waymo announced on September 14 that it aims to launch commercial robotaxi service in Tokyo in 2027, subject to national and local regulatory approval. The Alphabet unit first revealed its Japan plans in December 2024 and has been running supervised autonomous test drives since 2025 with taxi operator Nihon Kotsu and mobility platform GO. The commercial rollout would start with a small number of vehicles and scale to about 100, covering major Tokyo districts.
items.why_zh: 这是 Waymo 首次明确美国以外市场的商业化时间表，也是日本应对出租车司机短缺的重要尝试。
items.why_en: It is Waymo's first clear commercialization timeline outside the US and a notable attempt to address Japan's taxi-driver shortage.
